why: B's light birch/ash pieces (desk, glass-door bookcase, pale rocker) match the Nordic light-wood brief and the room's oak floor, and the bookcase wall fills the tall white wall. A's white bookcase is narrow, and its dark-brown armchair clashes with the light-wood palette, so it looks less cohesive. Both share the same desk, chair and lamp; the warm honey-oak chair is a near miss against the pale ash desk.
